name: Pixelate transition
summary: Grid of square blocks fills the frame (or clears it) in a shuffled order; a retro digital scene change.

params.name: mode
params.note: in fills the frame with blocks, out clears it

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different block order

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
